sections.title: Keep later repair access understandable
sections.text: We will record the opening addressed and identify any adjustment or removal included for a future visit. The permanent provider will need its own measurements and assessment. Temporary protection does not override entry restrictions or determine occupancy readiness.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/cross-timb.estimate: The estimate will state installation and authorized access handling, with later return work separately identified. Share photographs showing the room approach as well as the damaged opening.
checklist: Identify items blocking the installation area.
Confirm the authorized entry arrangement.
Share the planned permanent repair visit.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/cross-timber.intro: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Cross Timber can be needed when a release has affected insulation and accessible floor framing in the same section. We will explain the different material tasks rather than describe the project as removal alone.

sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Cross Timber across different components
sections.text: Insulation proposed for removal and framing considered for retained-surface treatment require separate decisions. We will identify the accessible condition and explain the scope for each. Removing one component will not automatically establish that the adjoining material has been addressed.

sections.title: Use clearing to reveal the remaining work
sections.text: Authorized removal can expose additional surfaces needing review. We will record those findings and explain any change to cleaning, drying or evaluation. Areas still inaccessible will remain identified rather than be included in a blanket completion statement.

sections.title: Prepare replacement from the actual cleanup record
sections.text: The provider installing new material needs to know where the relevant work is complete and where another step remains. We will supply that location-based account and identify source or moisture concerns still pending. Replacement should not cover an unresolved assembly.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/cross-timber.estimate: The estimate will distinguish component removal, retained-surface work and drying from plumbing repair and reconstruction. Share the source-repair notes and any replacement proposal already prepared.
checklist: Identify material removed before our visit.
Share the repaired line location.
Tell us who will replace insulation or other components.
